comments.body: they should start add selling price info

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
They did. If you click on Market Rates in the Nanban Trade section:

Market Rates - Japan

... it brings up a convenient chart showing what zones (European or otherwise) offer good/high prices for specific EA regional goods (Japan, in this case). Now, I seem to recall the listed prices are not entirely up to date with the EA goods price nerf introduced in 2nd Age; nevertheless, it's a very good guide that, so far as I know, is still a reliable point of reference as to where you can sell your goods for the best possible profit, crashed markets and other factors not withstanding, of course.

And players like us are more than welcome to post their own findings, too.
